en.full_desc:
Podcast strategy, audio and video recording, editorial production, post production and social content for brands, institutions, experts and creators worldwide.

A podcast succeeds when people choose to return for the next conversation.

Clear sound and strong visuals matter, but they are only part of the production.

The show also needs a distinct purpose, the right host, a repeatable format and enough editorial discipline to remain interesting across episodes.

Global Untold Story develops and produces audio and video podcasts for brands, companies, institutions, executives and creators.

We can build a new show from the beginning, improve an existing format or manage the recurring production of an entire season.

Our work can cover everything from concept development and studio production to editing, social clips, transcripts, localization and publishing support.

BUILD A SHOW, NOT JUST AN EPISODE

Many podcasts begin with enthusiasm and stop after a few recordings.

The problem is rarely the equipment.

It is usually the absence of a clear format, realistic production workflow and long term content plan.

Before recording begins, we define:

Who the show is for

Why the audience should care

What makes the conversation distinctive

How each episode should be structured

How often the show can realistically be produced

What content should be created from every recording

How the show should develop over time

The result is a format that can remain consistent without making every episode feel the same.

PODCASTS WE PRODUCE

Our podcast production services can support:

Branded podcasts

Corporate podcasts

Business and leadership shows

Interview podcasts

Video podcasts

Educational podcasts

Financial and economic programs

Cultural and entertainment shows

Internal company podcasts

Government and institutional programs

Industry and technical podcasts

Founder and executive conversations

Creator led shows

Event based podcast series

Remote and hybrid podcasts

Limited documentary podcast series

Bilingual podcast formats

Talent led conversation series

Each format is shaped around its audience, subject and intended platform.

PODCAST PRODUCTION CAPABILITIES

PODCAST STRATEGY AND CONCEPT DEVELOPMENT

A podcast needs a reason to exist beyond the desire to start one.

We help define the show’s purpose, audience, positioning and editorial territory before deciding how it should look or sound.

Development can include:

Show concept

Audience definition

Editorial positioning

Show name and description

Episode structure

Recurring segments

Guest strategy

Host role

Tone of voice

Season direction

Publishing rhythm

Content extension plan

Platform direction

Launch strategy

The objective is to create a show people can recognize, understand and return to.

FORMAT AND SEASON DESIGN

A good conversation may create one strong episode.

A strong format creates a sustainable series.

We design a repeatable production structure that supports different guests and subjects while maintaining the identity of the show.

Format planning can include:

Episode duration

Opening and closing structure

Segment flow

Interview style

Host and cohost roles

Guest categories

Recurring questions

Audience interaction

Episode themes

Season narrative

Recording schedule

Review and approval process

Publishing schedule

Season development plan

The format should make production easier without making the conversation predictable.

EPISODE RESEARCH AND PLANNING

Preparation helps the host listen more closely and ask better questions.

Before each recording, we can research the guest, subject and wider context to identify the strongest areas of conversation.

Episode planning can include:

Guest research

Topic research

Episode angles

Interview themes

Questions and follow up areas

Fact and reference notes

Opening hooks

Talking points

Timing guidance

Sensitive subjects

Required visuals or references

Promotional moments

Potential social clips

Episode title direction

The host receives enough structure to feel prepared without turning the conversation into a scripted interview.

HOST AND GUEST PREPARATION

The quality of the show depends heavily on the people in front of the microphones.

Some hosts need help with pacing and follow up questions. Others need support managing time or creating clearer transitions.

Guests may need reassurance, context and a better understanding of the conversation before recording.

Our support can include:

Host coaching

Interview technique

Listening and follow up skills

Timing and segment control

Camera awareness

Guest briefing

Speaker preparation

Teleprompter support where required

On camera direction

Performance feedback

Practice recordings

Season development coaching

The goal is not to remove personality.

It is to help the host use it more effectively.

PODCAST STUDIO PRODUCTION

We produce podcasts in dedicated studios, temporary sets and client locations depending on the needs of the show.

The production setup is built around the number of speakers, visual direction and required deliverables.

Studio production can include:

Space planning

Camera positioning

Microphone selection

Audio monitoring

Lighting

Set styling

Brand integration

Screens and background content

Recording supervision

Guest coordination

Production management

Media backup

Crew coordination

Technical rehearsals

We can work inside an existing studio or build the complete recording environment around the format.

VIDEO PODCAST PRODUCTION

Video podcasts are consumed across YouTube, social media and streaming platforms as much as they are heard through traditional podcast applications.

We produce single camera and multi camera video podcasts designed to generate complete episodes and strong shorter content from the same recording.

Video production can include:

Multi camera direction

Cinematic camera packages

Speaker close ups

Wide conversation coverage

Lighting design

Product and brand integration

Live switching where required

Isolated camera recording

Clean and branded outputs

Vertical content coverage

Photography

Behind the scenes material

Remote guest integration

Program and clean recordings

The visual style should support the conversation rather than distract from it.

AUDIO RECORDING AND ENGINEERING

Listeners may forgive a simple image.

They rarely forgive unclear sound.

We select and manage the audio setup according to the speakers, room and intended tone of the show.

Audio production can include:

Microphone selection

Individual speaker recording

Audio monitoring

Level control

Room assessment

Noise management

Backup recording

Remote guest audio

Music and playback

Sound checks

File organization

Recording supervision

Multi track recording

Technical quality control

Every voice should sound clear, natural and consistent across the series.

SET DESIGN, LIGHTING AND VISUAL IDENTITY

A podcast set should immediately communicate the character of the show.

The environment may feel intimate, authoritative, energetic or informal depending on the subject and audience.

Visual development can include:

Set concept

Furniture and layout

Background design

Practical lighting

Screen content

Brand placement

Props and styling

Camera friendly color choices

Host and guest positions

Temporary studio builds

Multiple visual zones

Seasonal updates

Modular set elements

Photography direction

The set should be visually distinctive while remaining practical for repeated production.

REMOTE AND HYBRID PODCAST PRODUCTION

Remote guests can expand the quality and range of contributors, but poor preparation can make the episode feel disconnected.

We support remote and hybrid recordings through technical testing, guest guidance and structured recording workflows.

Support can include:

Guest connection testing

Microphone and headphone guidance

Camera placement

Lighting guidance

Remote recording platforms

Local recording backups

Connection monitoring

Separate audio recording

Remote direction

Visual consistency

File transfer

Hybrid editing

Remote guest preparation

Backup connection planning

The remote guest should feel like part of the show, not an emergency video call.

PODCAST EDITING AND POST PRODUCTION

Editing should improve the conversation without removing its personality.

We refine pacing, remove unnecessary repetition and strengthen the structure while preserving the natural rhythm between the speakers.

Post production can include:

Audio editing

Video editing

Conversation tightening

Noise reduction

Audio repair

Mixing and mastering

Camera switching

Color correction

Music integration

Titles and graphics

Intro and outro sequences

Final quality control

Episode versioning

Platform ready exports

The level of editing is adapted to the format.

Some shows benefit from a polished structure. Others need to remain loose and conversational.

BRANDING AND MOTION DESIGN

A recognizable visual and audio identity helps the show feel established from the first episode.

Podcast branding can include:

Show logo

Cover artwork

Intro and outro sequences

Music direction

Lower thirds

Guest names

Topic titles

Transitions

Social templates

Thumbnail systems

Quote cards

Animated graphics

Sponsor integrations

Episode title systems

Visual usage guidelines

These elements create consistency across complete episodes, social content and publishing platforms.

CLIPS, HIGHLIGHTS AND SOCIAL CONTENT

One episode should create more than one piece of content.

We identify the strongest ideas, reactions and exchanges from each recording, then adapt them into formats designed for discovery and social sharing.

Content can include:

Short vertical clips

Interview highlights

Strong opening hooks

Quote moments

Educational extracts

Guest insights

Teasers

Episode trailers

YouTube Shorts

Instagram Reels

TikTok clips

LinkedIn videos

Audiograms

Quote graphics

Thumbnail assets

Platform specific cutdowns

The clip strategy should reflect the audience and platform rather than applying the same edit everywhere.

TRANSCRIPTS, SHOW NOTES AND SEARCH CONTENT

Podcast conversations contain valuable information that can support search visibility and long term content discovery.

We prepare written materials that make episodes easier to understand, navigate and repurpose.

Deliverables can include:

Full transcripts

Edited transcripts

Episode summaries

Show notes

Guest biographies

Key takeaways

Chapters and timestamps

Article drafts

Social captions

Video descriptions

Search focused titles

Newsletter content

Quote selections

Website episode pages

A well organized episode can become the source for articles, social posts and future content themes.

PUBLISHING AND PLATFORM DELIVERY

The final episode needs to reach the audience in the correct format.

Depending on the scope, we can provide publishing support and organized delivery for:

YouTube

Spotify

Apple Podcasts

Podcast hosting platforms

Company websites

Internal platforms

Social media channels

Private subscriber feeds

Support may include:

Platform ready files

Episode titles

Descriptions

Thumbnails

Chapters

Metadata

Captions

Upload support

Publishing calendars

Organized episode archiving

Quality checks

Release coordination

Ongoing platform management and audience growth support can also be included where required.

LOCALIZATION AND INTERNATIONAL VERSIONS

A podcast can reach different markets without losing the tone that made the original conversation valuable.

Localization support can include:

Arabic and English subtitles

Multilingual subtitles

Closed captions

Transcript translation

Voice over

Dubbing

Graphic replacement

Localized titles and descriptions

Textless versions

International delivery packaging

Language specific thumbnails

Localized social clips

Localization should preserve the meaning, personality and rhythm of the speakers.

ONE RECORDING. A COMPLETE CONTENT SYSTEM.

The value of a podcast is not limited to the full episode.

A well planned recording can create:

Full audio episode

Full video episode

Short social clips

Episode trailer

Guest highlights

Quote graphics

Audiograms

Transcripts

Articles

Newsletter content

Internal communication material

Photography

Future compilation episodes

Website content

Search focused material

This allows brands and creators to build a steady content presence without producing every asset separately.

PODCAST PRODUCTION FOR BRANDS AND INSTITUTIONS

A branded podcast should provide genuine value to the audience.

It should not feel like an extended advertisement or a company presentation disguised as a conversation.

We help brands and institutions develop shows around subjects they have the credibility, access or experience to discuss.

A branded podcast can support:

Thought leadership

Executive visibility

Industry education

Customer relationships

Employer branding

Internal communication

Community building

Research and insight

Product education

Institutional storytelling

Cultural conversation

Long term brand authority

Stakeholder engagement

Talent development

The brand earns attention by contributing something useful to the conversation.

RECURRING PODCAST PRODUCTION

Consistency is one of the hardest parts of podcast production.

A recurring show needs a workflow covering guests, research, recording, approvals, editing, clips and publishing.

We can create a recurring production system that includes:

Season planning

Guest pipelines

Recording calendars

Episode research

Studio booking

Production crews

Editorial review

Post production

Social content

Publishing support

Performance review

Archive organization

Approval workflows

Content planning

The system is built around a schedule the client can realistically maintain.

WHY WORK WITH GLOBAL UNTOLD STORY?

We approach podcasts as shows and content properties, not isolated recording sessions.

Clients bring us in when they need:

A podcast developed from concept to launch

Audio and video production under one team

A repeatable format and production workflow

Strong host and guest preparation

Cinematic video without compromising the conversation

Clear audio and consistent technical standards

Complete episodes and social content from one recording

Arabic and English production communication

Branding, post production and localization

Recurring production across complete seasons

A partner prepared to question, contribute and take ownership

We build the structure around the conversation, then create everything the show needs to grow.

WHAT WE NEED TO PREPARE A PROPOSAL

To understand the show and recommend the right production structure, it is helpful to receive:

Podcast concept

Intended audience

Audio, video or combined format

Preferred language

Proposed host

Guest structure

Episode duration

Number of episodes

Recording frequency

Preferred studio or location

Visual references

Required social content

Publishing platforms

Required languages

Launch date

Approval structure

Existing brand guidelines

Budget guidance where available

A finished format is not essential.

We can join while the idea is still being developed.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

DO YOU PROVIDE COMPLETE PODCAST PRODUCTION SERVICES?

Yes. We provide podcast development, audio and video recording, studio production, editing, social clips, transcripts, localization and publishing support.

CAN YOU DEVELOP THE PODCAST CONCEPT?

Yes. We can help define the audience, positioning, format, episode structure, guest strategy, publishing rhythm and visual identity.

DO YOU PRODUCE VIDEO PODCASTS?

Yes. We provide single camera and multi camera video podcast production, including lighting, sound, direction and post production.

CAN YOU BUILD A PODCAST STUDIO AT OUR OFFICE OR EVENT?

Yes. We can create a temporary or recurring podcast setup at a client office, conference, exhibition or other suitable location.

DO YOU HELP PREPARE HOSTS AND GUESTS?

Yes. We support hosts with interview technique, episode structure, timing and on camera performance.

Guests can also receive technical and editorial preparation.

CAN YOU PRODUCE SOCIAL CLIPS FROM EVERY EPISODE?

Yes. We can create vertical videos, highlights, teasers, audiograms, quote graphics and platform specific content from each recording.

DO YOU PROVIDE REMOTE RECORDING?

Yes. We support remote and hybrid recordings through technical testing, remote direction and separate audio and video capture.

CAN YOU EDIT A PODCAST RECORDED BY ANOTHER TEAM?

Yes. We can provide audio editing, video editing, mixing, mastering, graphics and social content for material recorded elsewhere.

CAN YOU HELP PUBLISH THE PODCAST?

Yes. We can prepare the final files, titles, descriptions, thumbnails, captions and metadata.

Uploading and ongoing platform management can also be included depending on the scope.

CAN YOU PRODUCE ARABIC AND ENGLISH PODCASTS?

Yes. We produce Arabic, English and bilingual podcasts, with subtitles, transcripts and localization available for additional markets.

CAN YOU MANAGE A COMPLETE PODCAST SEASON?

Yes. We can manage guest coordination, research, studio production, editing, social content, delivery and publishing workflows across a recurring season.

CAN YOU PRODUCE LIVE OR EVENT BASED PODCASTS?

Yes. We can create podcast and interview setups inside conferences, exhibitions, launches and other events, subject to venue and technical requirements.

HOW MUCH DOES PODCAST PRODUCTION COST?

The budget depends on the number and duration of episodes, studio requirements, cameras, set design, research, editing, social content and publishing scope.

Sharing the intended format and season structure allows us to recommend a realistic production approach and budget direction.

HOW LONG DOES PODCAST PRODUCTION TAKE?

The timeline depends on the development stage, episode frequency, guest availability, production setup, post production scope and approval process.

A pilot episode can be produced before committing to a complete season.

BUILD THE CONVERSATION PEOPLE RETURN TO

Whether you are creating a branded podcast, executive series, educational show or creator led format, we can build the complete production around the idea.

Share the concept, intended audience, episode structure and required outputs. Our team will review the brief and respond within one business day with the right questions and next steps.
